title: Accounts Payable Associate
description:
About us:
Zelh is a fast-growing, passionate outsourcing company.
Our mission is to be the most reliable company by offering and maintaining consistently high-quality services.
We achieve our mission by fostering long-term relationships with customers, employees, and vendors. Personal attention, timely communication, and respect for all people are the basis of our business philosophy!
We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Accounts Payable Associate to join our Finance team. In this role, you will be responsible for processing invoices and payments accurately and on time, maintaining vendor records, resolving invoice discrepancies, and supporting accurate month-end reporting.
The ideal candidate has experience with accounts payable or accounting administrative tasks, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting deadlines.

Key Responsibilities:

• Invoice Processing: Process invoices for payment, verify required information and account codes, and enter invoice data accurately into the system.

• Payment Processing: Schedule and process payments accurately and on time while ensuring all payments have the appropriate authorization.

• Vendor Communication: Respond to vendor inquiries, research payment-related questions, and resolve invoice discrepancies in a timely manner.

• Vendor Records: Maintain accurate vendor records and ensure all required documentation is properly collected and maintained.

• Month-End Support: Assist with month-end, quarter-end, and year-end accounts payable processes to ensure accurate and timely financial reporting.

• Invoice & Statement Review: Review vendor statements and outstanding invoices, identify overdue items, and follow up with vendors when necessary.

• Reporting & Record-Keeping: Maintain accurate accounting and financial records and prepare regular or ad hoc reports as required.

• Team Support: Collaborate with the Finance team, contribute to process improvements, and assist with training team members when required.

• Administrative Support: Perform other finance and administrative duties related to accounts payable as assigned.

Job requirements:

• 2+ years of experience in Accounts Payable, accounting, or a related administrative finance role.

• Knowledge of accounts payable processes and financial record-keeping practices.

• Experience reviewing financial documents for accuracy and completeness.

• Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.

• Good knowledge of standard business arithmetic, including percentages and decimals.

• Good English communication skills, both written and verbal.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to meet deadlines.

• Ability to research and resolve discrepancies independently.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other accounting or financial software.

• Ability to work independently while also contributing effectively to a team.

• High level of responsibility, discretion, and attention to confidential financial information.

Working conditions:

• Work schedule: Mon-Fri, 8 AM-5 PM CST

• Competitive salary in USD

• 10+ business days of paid time off

• Team building and corporate events

• Equipment provided

• Supportive and collaborative team

title: Software Engineer - Multi-Agent UAV Autonomy (Defense)
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT SEOUL

Applied Intuition entered the Korean market in 2020. The team has rapidly grown over the past few years and established strategic relationships with major Korean automotive OEM customers. Based in Gangnam, the Seoul site consists of employees who previously come from LG, Ansys, Unity, and other renowned companies.

About the Role

Our defense customers are building fleets of unmanned aerial systems that have to fly, coordinate, and complete missions in the real world. We build the tools they use to develop that autonomy. Building those tools well, and knowing they hold up outside of simulation, requires engineers who have done this work themselves.

We are seeking a Software Engineer to join our Korea office to build Applied Intuition's multi-agent autonomy development tools. This on-site role focuses on the capabilities defense customers rely on to design, train, and validate coordinated UAV behavior. You will collaborate frequently with our U.S. product engineering team, and work directly with Korean defense customers to translate their operational requirements into product capabilities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design, develop, and maintain core features of Applied Intuition’s autonomy development tools, with a focus on multi-agent mission planning, coordination, and training workflows.

- Validate that our tools hold up in practice: build reference multi-agent UAV autonomy on top of the product, exercise the full workflow from simulation through deployment on real airframes, and turn what breaks into product requirements.

- Define how simulation should be used across the development cycle, including where fidelity matters, how tuning and validation workflows should be structured, and what it takes to close the gap between simulated and real flight behavior.

- Collaborate frequently with US-based product and engineering teams to deliver features on shared roadmaps, operating as the Korea-based extension of the global product teams.

- Contribute to system-level design and architecture, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance.

- Run technical deep dives with Korean defense customers on selected features, probing their operational requirements, clarifying ambiguous needs, and translating what you learn into product specifications and roadmap input.

- Guide customers on how to get the most out of our tools when developing their own multi-agent unmanned systems, drawing on your own hands-on experience.

- Mentor engineers and share domain knowledge across the Korea team.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineerin

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year - far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Ramp is redefining how businesses manage their finances, and our growth marketing team is how millions of businesses first hear that story. As we expand internationally, paid ads are one of our highest-leverage channels - and localized, high-craft creative is what makes them work in a new market.

Based in our London office, you'll own the creative that powers Ramp's international acquisition engine across Meta, LinkedIn, Reddit, and Direct Mail. You'll take the playbook we've built in the US and adapt it for the UK and EU - shaping how Ramp shows up across paid social, video, and display for international audiences. You'll work closely with our Performance Marketing team to turn ideas into ads that move metrics, while pushing the creative bar on what a finance brand can look and feel like abroad.

- Iterate quickly based on performance data and contribute to international testing strategy.

- Build templates, automations, AI workflows, and creative systems that increase team velocity.

- Explore new tools, techniques, and AI-native workflows to expand what's possible inside our production pipeline.

- Help evolve how Ramp's brand shows up across international growth marketing.

- 5+ years of experience in visual design, motion design, or creative production

- Strong portfolio demonstrating both static and motion work

- Experience creating performance-driven creative for paid acquisition channels

- Strong taste and a clear point of view on what makes great advertising - with an eye for what resonates in UK/EU markets

- Comfort working in a fast-paced, test-and-learn environment where speed and iteration matter

- Ability to use performance data and business outcomes as creative feedback

- Comfort collaborating with a primarily US-based team across time zones

- Expertise in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (particularly After Effects)

- Based in or able to work from the London office

Nice-to-Haves

- Experience building automations, templates, component systems, scripts, or internal creative tooling

- Fluency with AI tools such as Runway, Veo, Kling, Midjourney, ElevenLabs, Claude Code, or similar

- Experience creating short-form video for Reels, Shorts, TikTok, and paid

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Study Now runs Global Student Pathway (GSP), a production education marketplace and student-recruitment platform used daily by counsellors, admissions officers and agent partners across nine destination markets. We have just brought the platform fully in-house, and you will be the person who makes it boringly reliable: deployed safely, monitored properly, backed up provably, and secure enough to hold student visa and identity documents.
What you’ll do

•

Assess and harden our estate across Linode and DigitalOcean, fronted by Cloudflare - topology, regions, MongoDB, storage - and own the resilience plan from day one, against defined targets: 99.9% uptime, 4-hour recovery from total provider failure (RTO), no more than 1 hour of data loss (RPO).

•

Build the 3-2-1 backup regime: hourly encrypted MongoDB dumps to a second region, automatic off-provider replication, a local encrypted archive - proven by monthly restore drills, not assumed to work.

•

Build and maintain CI/CD for our MEAN-stack application so releases ship with zero downtime - rolling restarts behind a load balancer, then blue-green - with the QA team’s automated suite wired in as a release gate.

•

Run monitoring, alerting and incident response: uptime, error rates and performance visible at all times, with alerts reaching the right person before users notice; write and rehearse the disaster-recovery runbook.

•

Own the security posture: secrets management, access control, Cloudflare WAF and rules, security-audit remediation, and UK GDPR alignment for the student data GSP holds (passports, visa documents, education records).

•

Manage cloud costs across providers, report spend monthly, and evaluate consolidation or AWS-based recovery on evidence - our current position is hardened-in-place with off-provider backup.

•

Document everything as runbooks usable by our two engineers without you on the call - a small team means no tribal knowledge.

What we’re looking for

•

4+ years running production infrastructure for a live web application, including at least one platform you were personally accountable for.

•

Hands-on with the pieces we run: Linux servers on Linode/DigitalOcean (or similar VPS providers), Cloudflare (DNS, caching, WAF), Docker, and CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or similar); infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or Ansible) strongly preferred.

•

MongoDB operations in production: replica sets, backups, restores and migrations under load.

•

Deploying and operating Node.js applications - our stack is MEAN (MongoDB, Express, Angular, Node).

•

Evidence of security thinking: hardening, secrets management, access reviews; experience preparing for or remediating a security audit is a strong plus.

•

Comfortable being the only infrastructure person: pragmatic, communicative, biased to documentation and automation over heroics.

Nice to have
Experience in edtech, CRM-style platforms or other systems holding sensitive personal data; UK GDPR / Cyber Essentials familiarity; experience taking over a platform from a departing team.
Working with us
Remote from India, employed through an employer-of-record or as a direct contractor (agreed at offer). Company laptop provided.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

While this role carries no personnel management responsibilities, the Product Lead Engineer has the highest technical voice within the team - setting direction, making implementation calls, and ensuring the team delivers reliable, well-engineered software. Beyond their own contributions, their output raises the technical capability of everyone around them.
WHAT WILL YOU BE DOING?
1. Technical Team Leadership

• Serve as the technical authority within the development teams, making implementation decisions, resolving technical disagreements, and ensuring the team operates to a consistently high engineering standard.

• Lead end-to-end delivery of complex features across backend, frontend, and mobile platforms - from design through deployment and monitoring - while actively guiding teammates through their portions of the work.

• Decompose ambiguous requirements into well-scoped tasks for the team, and proactively identify and address technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and reliability risks.

• Regularly and actively contribute production code - this is a player-coach role. The Product Lead Engineer is expected to be a consistent, high-quality committer and to model the engineering standards to which the rest of the organization is held.

2. Technical Leadership & Mentorship

• Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews that improve quality and accelerate the growth of junior engineers.

• Mentor Software Engineers through pairing, design discussions, and regular technical guidance.

• Drive best practices for testing, branching, documentation, and security within the team.

3. Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Collaborate with Product, QA, and Customer Success to clarify requirements, estimate accurately, and deliver reliable features on schedule.

• Communicate clearly and proactively about technical risks, progress, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

4. Technical Ownership & Cross-Training

• Take primary ownership of one or more significant product areas - maintaining deep expertise in their architecture, behavior, and failure modes, and serving as the authoritative resource for decisions and issues in those areas.

• Proactively lead knowledge transfer of your owned areas to teammates, ensuring the team can operate effectively without you and no single engineer becomes a bottleneck.

• Actively participate in cross-training led by others, developing meaningful familiarity with product areas outside your primary ownership to strengthen overall team resilience.

PERFORMANCE STANDARDS
Technical Quality

• Code, designs, and architectural decisions within the domain consistently meet peer review standards without significant rework.

• Technical debt and reliability risks in areas of ownership trend downward over time.

Delivery & Reliability

• Complex features are delivered on schedule with accurate estimation; risks are surfaced early with proposed mitigations.

CENTRL is a leading risk and compliance technology company that provides AI powered enterprise-grade risk, due diligence, cyber security and privacy management solutions to financial institutions worldwide. Our clients include some of the largest banks and investment management firms across the Americas, Europe and APAC. Headquartered in Silicon Valley, CENTRL has regional offices in New York, India, Australia, and the United Kingdom. Established in 2015, CENTRL is a high-growth, venture backed SaaS firm leading the way in innovative generative AI solutions to manage third party risk and due diligence.

Position Overview:

We are looking for an owner for the accuracy, reliability, and cost-efficiency of the AI behind CentrlX, our agentic platform for Manager Research and Investor Relations teams at investment firms.

We have a strong engineering team building the platform: agents, skills, knowledge, automations, connectors, and governance. We are looking for a single owner for output accuracy and efficiency.

You will own the model and prompt layer end to end. You will build the evaluation datasets and harnesses that tell us whether a change actually helped, run structured comparisons across model providers on accuracy, latency, and cost, and drive the resulting changes into the product. You will help create and design agents and skills, and work closely with sales and PS in order to help drive standards for prompting and agents, and then feed that back into the product design. You will do a real share of this work yourself from prompt iteration to writing user facing stories like incorporating interactive feedback. While we have support teams to intake client issues and fix them, you will own AI Quality and be the point person for what is happening and what needs to improve.

• Evaluate agent behavior, not just single responses: tool selection, retrieval quality, step sequencing, and whether the finished deliverable holds up to a practitioner's review.

• Turn every real client failure into a permanent eval case, so the same class of error does not come back.

Model Selection & Cost Optimization

• Continuously benchmark models across providers - OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open-weight, and specialized document models - on accuracy, latency, and cost for each workflow, and make the call on what we run where.

• Own model migrations end to end, including our in-flight move off GPT-4.1 in document digitization, where current alternatives are materially faster, cheaper, and more accurate.

• Track and manage AI spend by workflow, and use routing, model tiering, caching, and context strategy to hold quality while bringing cost down.

• Maintain a working view of the model landscape - releases, pricing changes, deprecations - and turn it into a recommendation with evidence attached, not a newsletter.

Instrumentation & Data

• Define the logging and tracing we need - prompt inputs, retrieved context, prompt text, outputs, tool calls, token counts, latency - and write the stories to get it built.

title: Trust & Safety Engineer
description:
TL;DR Millions of people build on Lovable every month. A small fraction try to abuse it. You'll build the adaptive systems that stop monetary fraud, platform abuse, and bot attacks before they reach our users.

WHY LOVABLE?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 5+ years building anti-fraud, anti-abuse, or risk systems at consumer scale (payments, marketplaces, fintech, or large social platforms).

- Strong backend engineering - Go, Python, or TypeScript - and comfort working close to the data.

- Experience with disrupting sophisticated fraud campaigns and attacks, knowledge of rules engines, real-time feature stores, ML scoring, device fingerprinting, and behavioral signals.

- You think in adversaries: you can model an attacker, ship a counter, and measure it before they adapt.

- Pragmatic about precision/recall trade-offs. You protect users without punishing them.

- Bonus: experience with LLM-specific abuse (prompt injection at scale, generated-content fraud, credit farming) or with chargeback and payments fraud at a Stripe/Adyen/Braintree-scale merchant.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Design and ship the fraud platform that protects Lovable's payments, credits, and free tier from abuse.

- Build real-time detection: signals, features, scoring, and decisioning that act in milliseconds.

- Run a tight feedback loop with chargebacks, support, and trust & safety to label, learn, and re-deploy weekly.

- Stand up bot defenses across signup, app generation, and publishing - without breaking legitimate users.

- Own the metrics that matter: fraud loss rate, false-positive rate, attacker time-to-defeat.

About your application

- Please submit your application in English - it’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join

- We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal

At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company - we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
The Role
Managed Services are provided to our customers after they go live with Veeva Quality applications. We aim to be our customers' trusted partners and ensure they leverage the additional value Veeva applications offer.
Our Quality Services Team comprises 60+ consultants in Europe, of which 15+ are in the Managed Services Team. We hire people from industry, tech, and consulting, which adds diversity to our team.

Your task will be understanding their business processes, providing guidance, discussing Vault changes, and applying all the required configurations. What You'll Do

• Implement new features within the Veeva Quality suite at Life Sciences companies ranging from the world’s largest pharmaceutical companies to emerging biotech

• Solutioning and configuration of Vault applications to meet customer needs, including but not limited to workflows, document types, security, fields, page layouts, notifications

• Work closely with customer's business and IT staff to understand their requirements. Think critically and help them achieve their business vision

• Act as customer liaison, managing communication between implementation and maintenance teams, customer stakeholders, and internal Veeva Product teams

• Guide customers in adopting Vault and industry best practices as part of post-implementation programs focused on the holistic success of the customer

• Drive change management methodology

title: Digital Competition - SPARK 2026
description:
Join us in the fight against SPARK!
In GSA's boardroom sits SPARK - a decades-old blade server, entombed forever in acrylic to be displayed as a proud reminder of GSA's journey.

SPARK was an invaluable step toward the sophisticated algorithms in use today, but was retired from active trading and destined never to be booted up again.

But last night, through a series of unfortunate errors, the server was reconnected to GSA's internal network. In the decades spent sitting on the boardroom shelf its algorithms have warped beyond recognition. SPARK now has a conscience of its own...

Sign up for SPARK today to prepare for the fight!

title: Scrum Master
description:
Role Profile: Scrum Master
Role Summary
The Scrum Master is responsible for enabling Agile practices within the team, ensuring adherence to Scrum principles, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. Acting as a servant leader, this role removes impediments, promotes collaboration, and drives successful delivery in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Key Responsibilities

• Facilitate Scrum ceremonies (Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Reviews, Retrospectives).

• Coach team members and stakeholders on Agile principles and the Scrum framework.

• Identify and remove obstacles to ensure smooth delivery.

• Promote a culture of continuous improvement and high performance.

• Collaborate with the Product Owner to ensure backlog clarity and prioritization.

• Track and report key metrics (velocity, burndown charts) to stakeholders.

• Ensure transparency and effective communication across teams and departments.

• Support scaling Agile practices across multiple teams when required.

• Drive adoption of Agile best practices and ensure compliance with organizational standards.

• Mentor new Scrum Masters and contribute to the Agile community within the organization.

• Facilitate cross-team coordination for dependencies and shared deliverables.

• Assist in defining and refining team goals and objectives aligned with business priorities.

• Work closely with leadership to identify opportunities for process optimization.

• Support risk management and proactively address delivery challenges.

• Champion team health by monitoring workload, morale, and engagement.

• Ensure proper use of Agile tools and maintain accurate documentation in Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.

• Participate in release planning and help align sprint goals with release objectives.

• Advocate for continuous learning by organizing workshops, training sessions, and knowledge sharing activities.

Qualifications
Education:
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Business, or related field (or equivalent experience).
Certifications:

• Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Professional Scrum Master (PSM) required.

• Additional Agile certifications (SAFe, PMI-ACP, ICAgile) are a plus.

Knowledge, Experience & Skills

• Strong understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe).

• Excellent facilitation, coaching, and conflict-resolution skills.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Familiarity with Agile tools (Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps).

• Knowledge of software development lifecycle and project management principles.

• 3-5 years of experience as a Scrum Master in Agile environments.

• Proven track record of delivering projects in fast-paced, high-pressure settings.

• Experience working with cross-functional teams and multiple stakeholders.

• Exposure to scaling frameworks (SAFe, LeSS) is desirable.

description:
🎤 WHY VOIZE? BECAUSE WE’RE MORE THAN JUST A JOB!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡 YOUR MISSION: KEEP 2,000+ CARE FACILITIES RUNNING

When voize works, nurses get 39 minutes of their shift back. When something breaks, a firewall silently blocking sync, an interface mismatch with a facility's care software or a regression after a release; documentation stops and care teams feel it immediately. Your mission: make sure that downtime is minimum, and never happens twice.

As Technical Support Manager, you own our technically hardest customer cases end-to-end. You work at the intersection of our AI product, real-world facility IT, and the German care software ecosystem - with a direct line to our Engineering team, not a ticket queue between you. And your work has leverage: one root cause you find and fix can resolve an issue for dozens or hundreds of facilities at once.

🚀 YOUR DAILY BUSINESS - NO TWO DAYS ARE ALIKE

- Own escalated cases from 1st-level support end-to-end: reproduce, isolate the fault across app, backend, customer network, and third-party systems and keep the customer clearly informed until it's solved

- Debug integrations with leading German care documentation systems: interface errors, data and schema mismatches, and on-prem configurations in customer environments (Windows/Linux)

- Untangle customer-side IT - firewalls, proxies, certificates, MDM-managed shared devices - often in direct coordination with a facility's IT

- Take the lead in critical incidents: assess which facilities are affected, drive resolution together with Engineering, and own clear, timely communication to customers and internal stakeholders

- Turn recurring issues into permanent fixes: root-cause analyses with Product & Engineering, input into pre-release QA, runbooks and knowledge-base articles - and mentor 1st-level colleagues along the way as you help shape our escalation playbooks

- Hands-on experience with observability/monitoring tools (Grafana, Sentry) and strong networking fundamentals (firewalls, proxies, DNS, TLS/certificates) - you can use logs, metrics, and traces to figure out why systems can't talk to each other

- Solid Windows and/or Linux system administration in enterprise or customer environments - you're at home in logs, configs, and the command line

- Hands-on experience with APIs and system integrations - you can read a payload and trace where data breaks between systems

- Experience owning 2nd/3rd-level escalations in complex environments

- German proficiency at C2 / billingual level - our customers work with us in German, so this is a hard requirement

🌱 GROWING TOGETHER - WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT AT VOIZE

- We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving healthcare professionals more time for real patient care

- We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely from Germany

- Become a co-creator of our success with stock options

- Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learnin

title: Financial Analyst, India
description:
This is a remote position.
Financial Analyst, India Remote (India) | Full-Time
Also searched as: Finance Analyst, FP&A Analyst, MIS Analyst, Business Analyst
What would you tell a leadership team about their own business that they have not thought to ask?
On a typical day you might reconcile the weekly scorecard numbers back to Xero and HubSpot before the leadership review in the morning, work through month-end variances with the Financial Controller and draft the commentary after lunch, and send a short written note on why a revenue line moved and what you would do about it before the end of day.
About Contour
We started in 2020 with a handful of students and a belief that great education should not be out of reach. Today we operate across three brands with 8,000+ students and 425+ team members: roughly 100 in India and 325 onshore in Australia. The India team runs publishing, student experience, CRM and technology, operations, and people and culture, and this role sits with the group finance function.
A company growing this fast is steered by the numbers someone puts in front of it each week. This is that seat.
About This Role
You're Contour's first Financial Analyst, and the senior of the first two India-based seats in group finance, alongside an Accountant who runs the transactional side. You own the analytical layer: the monthly reporting leadership reads, the weekly scorecard the business runs on, budget vs actual tracking, and the analysis behind decisions. You report to the Financial Controller, who owns the budgeting and forecasting, statutory reporting, management reporting, tax, and final sign-off of all financial data. Leadership decides which metrics matter; you make them measurable and reconciled, with the explanation attached.
Two things separate a strong hire here from a competent one. First, you're proactive by instinct: when a number moves, you find out why, form a view, and put a recommendation in front of the people who can act on it. You don't stop at what happened, you push to why it happened and what should happen next. Second, you build reporting to run itself, so your hours go into analysis, not copy-paste.
This analytical work has so far been carried alongside other jobs, not owned by one person. You change that: the weekly and monthly rhythm leadership runs on is being set up now, and you build it.
By month three, you own the monthly reporting cycle, the weekly leadership scorecard is live with agreed definitions and targets vs budget, budget vs actual reporting is standing, and at least one of your recommendations has been acted on. What you build here becomes how Contour reads its numbers as it scales.
Where the work lives

• Xero: actuals live here, so your reporting starts from, and ties back to, the ledger.

• Google Sheets: the working medium for models, budgets, and reporting packs, so clean structure and formulas someone else can follow are the baseline.

• HubSpot and Stripe: enrolment and payment data live here, so revenue analysis means joining what the CRM says with what actually settled.

• AI tools: Claude and similar are part of how this team works, so using them to build, draft, and check analysis is expected here, not a novelty.

• monday.com: task status moves here, and keeping yours current is how a remote team sees progress without having to ask.

What You Will Do

• Own the monthly management reporting pack. Build it, run it on a predictable cycle, and make it the version leadership trusts: actuals from Xero, enrolment and revenue from HubSpot and Stripe, with commentary on what changed and why.

• Run the weekly leadership scorecard. One set of numbers, agreed definitions, one source of truth, red-amber-green against targets. You keep definitions tight and figures reconciled so nobody argues whose number is right.

• Track the business against budget. The Financial Controller owns the budget; you own how we track against it. Build the reporting, explain variances, flag material

description:

Savvital is a forward-thinking organization that provides diversified services to small and medium-sized businesses in the international market, enabling them to build their future while benefiting from our customized solutions. Our team of educated experts are motivated individuals excited to handle tasks that add real capacity to a client's workday.

Our mission is to provide affordable solutions to growing companies through strategic task delegation. We envision creating an ecosystem that resonates with the human touch every business needs.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a highly analytical Supply Chain Forecasting & Data Analyst to support a growing supply chain and distribution operation.

This is a hands-on analytical role focused on turning historical sales and order data into demand forecasts, inventory insights, and actionable business recommendations .

You’ll work with large transactional datasets and be responsible for cleaning and validating data, identifying demand patterns, building forecasting models, analyzing SKU and customer behavior, and translating your findings into recommendations that business stakeholders can understand and act on.

This is not a data-entry or basic reporting role .

We’re looking for someone who can take raw, imperfect data, figure out what it is telling us, determine the right analytical approach, and build a reliable model from the ground up.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Demand Forecasting & Analysis

• Analyze historical sales and order data to identify demand patterns and purchasing behavior.

• Build rolling 12 to 18-month demand forecasts using historical purchasing trends.

• Analyze year-over-year demand and growth patterns.

• Annualize year-to-date usage where appropriate.

• Identify consistent, seasonal, sporadic, declining, and growing demand patterns.

• Account for differences in units of measure, product categories, and customer purchasing behavior.

• Identify unusual changes in demand, including spikes, drops, and zero-usage products.

Excel Modeling

• Build scalable forecasting and inventory analysis models in Microsoft Excel .

• Use advanced Excel functionality to transform raw transactional data into meaningful insights.

• Develop formulas, calculations, PivotTables, lookups, and analytical logic to support forecasting.

• Create recommendation logic that can identify opportunities such as:

• Validate with Customer

• Increase Stocking

• Maintain Current Stocking

• Evaluate for Reduction

• Build exception reporting and alerts for products requiring additional review.

• Test forecasting methodologies on representative datasets before scaling them more broadly.

• Document formulas, assumptions, calculations, and methodology so models can be reviewed and maintained.

Data Management & Quality

• Extract, organize, clean, and validate large datasets from ERP and other business systems.

• Work with raw transactional data and identify inconsistencies, missing information, duplicates, and data-quality issues.

• Determine how data issues may impact forecasting and analytical results.

• Establish appropriate data-cleaning and validation processes.

• Communicate data-quality concerns clearly to relevant stakeholders.

Inventory & Supply Chain Insights

• Analyze demand trends to support inventory and stocking decisions.

• Identify SKUs that may require increased or reduced stocking levels.

• Evaluate customer purchasing behavior and its potential impact on inventory requirements.

• Identify products with declining, inconsistent, or unusual demand.

• Support inventory planning and replenishment decisions through data-driven analysis.

• Develop insights that help balance product availability with inventory efficiency.

Reporting & Business Insights

• Create clear and easy-to-understand reports showing historical usage, demand trends, forecasts, and recommendations.

description:
At Algolia , we’re proud to be a pioneer and market leader in AI Search, empowering 18,000+ businesses to deliver blazing-fast, predictive search and browse experiences at internet scale. Every week, we power over 30 billion search requests - four times more than Microsoft Bing, Yahoo, Baidu, Yandex, and DuckDuckGo combined.

In 2021, we raised $150 million in Series D funding, quadrupling our valuation to $2.25 billion. This strong foundation enables us to keep investing in our market-leading platform and serving incredible customers like Under Armour, PetSmart, Stripe, Gymshark, and Walgreens.

As the Partner Manager for DACH, you will execute Algolia 's partner strategy across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, with Germany as the primary focus market. You'll work with consulting partners, systems integrators, technology partners and cloud partners to embed Algolia into the multi-technology - increasingly agentic - solutions they build and sell.

This is not a solutions engineering role - you won't be architecting or implementing client solutions. But it is a solutions-focused role: you need real technical fluency, and the ability to inspire partners and customers on the art of the possible with Algolia . In practice, that means identifying and shaping three kinds of agentic solutions: those that combine Algolia with one or more of our technology partners; those built by our consulting partners and brought to market by them; and those built jointly with technology partners around a shared value proposition that delivers real value to customers and end users. Pipeline development, opportunity progression and customer wins all matter - but they all start with getting the innovation right, with Algolia at the center of it.

Reporting to the Head of Global Partnerships, and working in close collaboration with the General Manager of DACH, you will develop and execute the regional partner strategy - deciding which consulting, systems integration, technology and cloud partners to prioritize, and building the technical and commercial motions that turn those relationships into pipeline and revenue.

Algolia 's partner motion in DACH is mature - we've been building relationships in the region for seven years. This role is an opportunity to build on that foundation: taking well-established partnerships to the next level, while also designing and standing up a partner-led growth strategy for the region.

YOUR ROLE WILL CONSIST OF:

• Developing and executing Algolia 's partner strategy across DACH, with Germany as the primary focus market alongside Austria and Switzerland

• Building on seven years of established partner relationships in the region, while designing and executing a new partner-led growth strategy for DACH

• Building and managing a portfolio of consulting partners, systems integrators, technology partners and cloud partners (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft) across the region

• Identifying, recruiting and onboarding new partners into the Algolia Partner Program, with particular attention to partners building agentic and AI-driven solutions

• Shaping and championing agentic solutions that combine Algolia with one or more of our technology partners

• Working with consulting partners to help them build their own agentic solutions on Algolia and bring those solutions to market

• Developing joint value propositions with technology partners for agentic solutions that deliver real value to customers and end users

• Acting as a solutions-focused innovator who can inspire partners and customers on the art of the possible with Algolia

• Developing a working technical understanding of partner architectures and solutions deep enough to guide partners on where and how Algolia fits - without owning implementation

• Enabling partners on Algolia 's product and technical capabilities so they can position, sell and deliver successfully

• Owning deal registration, pursuit prioritization and account mapping across the partner port

description:
Η Würth Hellas , μέλος του διεθνούς Ομίλου Würth και μία από τις κορυφαίες εταιρείες στον χώρο των επαγγελματικών εργαλείων και λύσεων, αναζητά Remote Telesales Representative για την ενίσχυση της ομάδας πωλήσεων. Η θέση είναι 100% εξ αποστάσεως και απευθύνεται σε υποψηφίους από όλη την Ελλάδα. Μετά από πλήρως αμειβόμενη εκπαίδευση ενός μήνα στα κεντρικά γραφεία της εταιρείας, θα εργάζεσαι από τον χώρο σου, έχοντας στη διάθεσή σου όλα τα απαραίτητα εργαλεία και τη συνεχή υποστήριξη της ομάδας μας.
Στη Würth Hellas πιστεύουμε ότι η επιτυχία ξεκινά από τους ανθρώπους μας. Επενδύουμε στην εκπαίδευση, παρέχουμε όλα τα απαραίτητα εργαλεία για να πετύχεις και δημιουργούμε ένα περιβάλλον συνεργασίας, αξιοκρατίας και συνεχούς εξέλιξης. Αν αναζητάς μια σταθερή επαγγελματική ευκαιρία σε μια εταιρεία με ισχυρή παρουσία στην ελληνική και διεθνή αγορά, θα χαρούμε να σε γνωρίσουμε.
Requirements

Αρμοδιότητες

• Διαχείριση και ανάπτυξη υφιστάμενου πελατολογίου επαγγελματιών.

• Τηλεφωνική επικοινωνία με πελάτες για την παρουσίαση προϊόντων, νέων λύσεων και εμπορικών προτάσεων.

• Διερεύνηση των αναγκών των πελατών και παροχή ολοκληρωμένων λύσεων.

• Δημιουργία, καταχώρηση και παρακολούθηση παραγγελιών.

• Ανάπτυξη σχέσεων εμπιστοσύνης και μακροχρόνιων συνεργασιών.

• Επίτευξη ποιοτικών και ποσοτικών στόχων.

Απαιτούμενα Προσόντα

• Πολύ καλές επικοινωνιακές δεξιότητες.

• Ευχέρεια στη διαχείριση πελατών και διαπραγμάτευση.

• Εμπορική αντίληψη και πελατοκεντρική προσέγγιση.

• Άνεση στη χρήση ηλεκτρονικού υπολογιστή και εφαρμογών Microsoft Office.

• Οργανωτικότητα, συνέπεια και υπευθυνότητα.

• Ικανότητα εργασίας σε περιβάλλον στόχων.

• Ομαδικό πνεύμα και διάθεση για συνεχή μάθηση.

• Προϋπηρεσία σε πωλήσεις ή εξυπηρέτηση πελατών θα θεωρηθεί επιπλέον προσόν.

Benefits

• Απομακρυσμένη εργασία μετά τον πρώτο μήνα εκπαίδευσης.

• Δυνατότητα εργασίας από όλη την Ελλάδα.

• Πλήρως αμειβόμενη εκπαίδευση διάρκειας ενός μήνα στα κεντρικά γραφεία της Würth Hellas στο Κρυονέρι Αττικής.

• Εταιρικός εξοπλισμός (laptop & εταιρικό κινητό).

• Ανταγωνιστικό πακέτο αποδοχών με επιπλέον bonus επίτευξης στόχων.

• Ιδιωτική ιατροφαρμακευτική ασφάλιση.

• Συνεχή εκπαίδευση και καθοδήγηση από έμπειρα στελέχη της εταιρείας.

• Σύγχρονο εργασιακό περιβάλλον με ξεκάθαρες προοπτικές εξέλιξης σε μια κορυφαία πολυεθνική εταιρεία.

title: Deployment Strategist - US Government
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
 
At its core, the Deployment Strategist role centers around leveraging data in operational and real-world action. Our customers come to us with a hunch that the only way to protect their troops, manufacture high-quality products, structure effective healthcare policies, or deliver aid to refugees safely is to make better use of their data. Deployment Strategists are responsible for turning that hunch into reality.

If you believe in the transformational power of data and technology and in your own ability to bring that power to bear against complex problems, we want to meet you.
 
What We Do
As a Deployment Strategist, you'll work as part of a driven and creative team of Engineers, Product Designers, and other Deployment Strategists to deploy software against the most challenging problems our world faces. Your mission is to synthesize disconnected streams of thought into a cohesive understanding of what the most important problem is, what the data means, what the product needs, what users are motivated by, and where the impact could be.

Deployment Strategists are do-ers who immerse themselves in our customers' most intricate workflows, partner with customer teams and explore the data, and dive into the product landscape to enable us to scale. A select number of Deployments Strategists may also be deployed to Palantir internal teams and problems. In this role, the problems you'll tackle will require a curious and analytical mindset, a sharp intuition for product, and a strong degree of user empathy to ultimately empower our customers to make better decisions.

Salary
 
The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $110,000 - $170,000/year. Total compensation for this position may also include Restricted Stock units, sign-on bonus and other potential future incentives. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any potential sign-on bonus; the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.

Our benefits aim to promote health and wellbeing across all areas of Palantirians’ lives. We work to continuously improve our offerings and listen to our community as we design and update them. The list below details our available benefits and some of the perks that can be enjoyed as an employee of Palantir Technologies.
 
Benefits
 
•  Employees (and their eligible dependents) can enroll in medical, dental, and vision insurance as well as voluntary life insurance
•  Employees are automatically covered by Palantir’s basic life, AD&D and disability insurance
•  Commuter benefits
•  Relocation assistance
•  Take what you need paid time off, not accrual based
•  2 weeks paid time off built into the end of each year (subject to team and business needs)
•  10 paid holidays throughout the calendar year
•  Supportive leave of absence program including time off for military service and medical events
•  Paid leave for new parents and subsidized back-up care for all parents
•  Fertility and family building benefits including but not limited to adoption, surrogacy, and preservation
•  Stipend to help with expenses that come with a new child
•  Employees can enroll in Palantir’s 401k plan
 
Life at Palantir
 
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. title: Audiovisual Specialist
description:
Position Summary
NV5 is a leading provider of compliance, technology, and engineering consulting solutions. As part of the technology group, services include planning and design in a wide range of specialty areas, including audiovisual, IT/telecommunications, building security, technical lighting, healthcare technologies, and architectural acoustics/noise vibration.
We play a significant role in shaping our communities through the services we provide and are looking for passionate, driven individuals to join our team focused on Delivering Solutions and Improving Lives.
The Audiovisual Field Specialist provides field inspection and commissioning services for our clients' technology-enriched spaces. The position will require that the candidate represent NV5 and our Client to observe site field conditions, inspect existing systems, and ensure installed systems accurately meet the design and operational intent and our client’s established standards.
This is a fully remote position, with frequent travel to client sites within the candidate's assigned geographical region.
Responsibilities

•

• Coordinate all work closely with both internal and external Project Managers

• Evaluate existing audiovisual and network systems and document site conditions in sufficient detail to support the client’s goals and inform recommended corrective actions.

• Prepare site reports that clearly identify existing conditions, deficiencies, roadblocks, and other observations requiring attention.

• Review and interpret audiovisual system drawings, electronic schematics, architectural plans, project documentation, and scopes of work to confirm installation quality, completeness, and alignment with the design intent

• Perform audiovisual field engineering and commissioning activities, including point-to-point testing and the setup, configuration, and verification of audio, video, control, and digital signal processing systems

• Configure IP-addressable devices and establish network communications. Upload and download control programs, develop DSP programming, and make minor programming changes under the direction of an engineer or programmer.

• Fine-tune audio, video, control, and DSP systems to support optimal performance and verify that completed installations meet established project requirements and client standards

• Develop, track, and close project punch lists; prepare final job documentation and follow-up reports; provide client training; and serve as the primary customer liaison when required.

• Travel frequently to project sites and perform additional tasks, responsibilities, and projects as needed to support the team and organization while adapting to evolving priorities and maintaining NV5 ’s standards for quality, schedule, and client service.

Requirements

• Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in technical audiovisual roles, including direct experience with field engineering, system commissioning, diagnostics, or related activities

• Strong knowledge of audiovisual systems, including projection and display systems; sound and speech reinforcement; conferencing and collaboration systems; digital signal processing; signal distribution and routing; and control systems

• Strong computer skills, including experience configuring networked audiovisual systems, establishing network parameters, and loading audio DSP and control system configuration files

• General knowledge of Information Technology services, network hardware, infrastructure, structured cabling, and system architecture

• Excellent attention to detail and strong oral and written communication skills, with a professional, customer service-focused approach appropriate for a client-facing position

• Values that include integrity, accountability, collaboration, and a commitment to delivering high-quality client service

• Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative project team

• Maintain a professional and positive attitude in a fast-paced an
